lotId.description: REQ-LOT-008: optional FK to the InventoryLot created/replenished by this receipt. Required when the receipt's product (Product.requiresLotTracking == true) is lot-tracked — the LotTrackingReceiptGuard enforces this on save.
lotId.title: Lot ID

lotRequiredForTrackedProduct.condition: @product.requiresLotTracking == true AND lotId IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(InventoryLot WHERE goodsReceiptId == @self.id)
lotRequiredForTrackedProduct.message: Lot number required for tracked item: receipt MUST reference an InventoryLot.
lotRequiredForTrackedProduct.messageNl: Lotnummer vereist voor gevolgd artikel: ontvangst MOET een InventoryLot referentie bevatten.

InventoryLot.title: Inventory Lot
InventoryLot.description: Lot/batch identifier for a homogeneous quantity of a Product received together (one supplier, one date, one expiry). Sits below InventoryStock — InventoryStock is the aggregate position per (sku, locationId); InventoryLot adds the per-lot granularity required for FEFO (First-Expiry-First-Out) picking, expiry tracking, quality quarantine, and recall traceability per REQ-LOT-001..009. Lifecycle: active → quarantined (release back) | expired (terminal) | exhausted (terminal, qty == 0). FEFO order is declared via x-openregister-sort on expiryDate ASC NULLS LAST so all consumers (pick list, expiry dashboard, batch reports) inherit FEFO ordering. ADR-031 exception path: if the declarative sort directive is advisory rather than enforced at the OR API layer, the single-method FefoSort::sortLots PHP guard in lib/Sort/ applies the order before the response leaves the controller. No bespoke PHP CRUD — spec REQ-LOT-001 prohibits parallel storage. Spec: inventory-lot-batch-expiry. The 'InventoryItem' wording in the spec refers to the shillinq Product schema.

lotNumber.description: Operator-visible lot/batch identifier per REQ-LOT-002. Unique per administration. Examples: LOT-2026-001, PF-KAT-A001.
lotNumber.title: Lot Number

batchCode.description: Supplier-assigned batch reference (often printed on the package). Distinct from lotNumber, which is the warehouse-assigned identifier.
batchCode.title: Batch Code

productId.description: FK to pipelinq Product (productId). Required. Resolved via ?expand=productId via ADR-019 integration registry.
productId.title: Product ID

productSku.description: TRANSITIONAL ALIAS: deprecated — use productId. Retained for 3-way-match fallback only. Will be removed after pipelinq-product-vendor-master is confirmed live.
productSku.title: Product SKU

manufactureDate.description: Date of manufacture / production. Used for shelf-life calculations and recall windows.
manufactureDate.title: Manufacture Date

expiryDate.description: Legal expiry date per REQ-LOT-002. Drives FEFO sort (ASC NULLS LAST) and the expired-state lifecycle transition. May be null for non-perishable items — FEFO order sorts null-expiry lots last.
expiryDate.title: Expiry Date

bestBeforeDate.description: Best-before quality date (EU food law THT). May precede expiryDate. Informational; does not drive lifecycle transitions.
bestBeforeDate.title: Best Before Date

quantity.description: Current available (un-consumed) quantity in this lot per REQ-LOT-002. Decremented by StockMove postings; when it reaches 0 the exhausted-state transition fires per REQ-LOT-006.
quantity.title: Quantity

unitCode.description: UN/CEFACT unit of measure code. Common values: ZAK (bag), BLIK (can), KG (kilogram), ST (piece), CA (carton).
unitCode.title: Unit Code

unitCost.description: Cost per unit at time of receipt in EUR (administration base currency). Used for FIFO/average inventory valuation per inventory-valuation-fifo-avg.
unitCost.title: Unit Cost

warehouseLocation.description: Physical bin / rack / shelf location code where this lot is stored. Free-text for now; future inventory-multi-warehouse spec consumes this for hierarchical Location mapping.
warehouseLocation.title: Warehouse Location

lotStatus.description: REQ-LOT-006 lifecycle state. active: available for picking; quarantined: held for quality inspection (not pickable); expired: past legal expiry (terminal, awaiting disposal); exhausted: quantity 0 (terminal, lot closed).
lotStatus.title: Lot Status

receivedDate.description: Date this lot was received into the warehouse. Defaults to today on create. Used for shelf-life and supplier-performance reports.
receivedDate.title: Received Date

goodsReceiptId.description: FK to the GoodsReceipt event that introduced this lot to the warehouse. Optional — lots may also be created manually (e.g. initial stock-take).
goodsReceiptId.title: Goods Receipt ID

administrationId.description: FK to Administration that owns this lot. Enforced via adminScope.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

notes.description: Operator-authored free text. Common uses: quarantine reason, recall reference, supplier remark.
notes.example: Droogvoer kat senior, leverancier Prins Petfoods
notes.title: Notes

x-openregister-sort.description: REQ-LOT-005: FEFO (First-Expiry-First-Out) default order. Lots without an expiryDate sort after all dated lots. ADR-031 exception: if OR's sort directive is advisory at the API query layer, OCA\Shillinq\Sort\FefoSort::sortLots applies the same order before the response is returned — documented in openspec/changes/inventory-lot-batch-expiry/design.md §D2.

active.label: Active
active.description: Available for picking. Default state on create. Counts toward on-hand FEFO availability.

quarantined.label: Quarantined
quarantined.description: Held for quality inspection per REQ-LOT-006. Not pickable. May be released back to active or transitioned to expired.

expired.label: Expired
expired.description: Terminal state. Past the legal expiryDate; not pickable; awaiting disposal. Reachable only when today > expiryDate (guard enforced).

exhausted.label: Exhausted
exhausted.description: Terminal state. quantity == 0; lot is closed. Reached automatically when a StockMove drains the lot to zero.

quarantine.label: Quarantine lot
quarantine.description: Operator or automated quality flag isolates a lot pending inspection per REQ-LOT-006.

release.label: Release from quarantine
release.description: Operator quality release returns the lot to pickable per REQ-LOT-006.

expireFromActive.label: Mark expired
expireFromActive.description: Daily expiry check OR operator transition. Requires today > expiryDate (guard) per REQ-LOT-006.

expiryDateReached.message: Cannot expire lot: expiry date not yet reached.
expiryDateReached.messageNl: Lot kan niet vervallen worden: vervaldatum nog niet bereikt.

expireFromQuarantine.label: Mark expired (from quarantine)
expireFromQuarantine.description: Quarantined lots that cross their expiry date follow the same expired transition per REQ-LOT-006.

expiryDateReached.message: Cannot expire lot: expiry date not yet reached.
expiryDateReached.messageNl: Lot kan niet vervallen worden: vervaldatum nog niet bereikt.

exhaust.label: Mark exhausted
exhaust.description: Automatic transition when StockMove drains the lot to zero per REQ-LOT-006 (postcondition: quantity == 0).

quantityZero.message: Cannot exhaust lot: quantity is greater than zero.
quantityZero.messageNl: Lot kan niet uitgeput worden: voorraad is groter dan nul.

nonNegativeQuantity.message: Lot quantity must be greater than or equal to zero.
nonNegativeQuantity.messageNl: Lothoeveelheid moet groter dan of gelijk aan nul zijn.

expiryAfterManufacture.condition: manufactureDate IS NOT NULL AND expiryDate IS NOT NULL AND expiryDate < manufactureDate
expiryAfterManufacture.message: Expiry date must be on or after manufacture date.
expiryAfterManufacture.messageNl: Vervaldatum moet op of na de productiedatum liggen.

ExpiryAlert.title: Expiry Alert
ExpiryAlert.description: Notification record for lots approaching expiry, lots that have crossed their expiry date, and lots received without an expiry date for tracked products per REQ-LOT-007. Distinct register (not embedded on InventoryLot) so multiple thresholds per lot can coexist (30-day + 7-day), acknowledgement is tracked independently of lot state, and the alert history remains queryable after a lot is exhausted or expired. Alert generation is the responsibility of a daily background job (LotExpiryAlertJob); the schema is read-only from the operator dashboard side except for the acknowledge / resolve transitions. Spec: inventory-lot-batch-expiry.

lotId.description: REQ-LOT-007: FK to InventoryLot.id — the lot triggering the alert. Resolves via ?expand=lotId.
lotId.title: Lot ID

alertType.description: REQ-LOT-007 alert taxonomy. approaching_expiry: lot crosses a configured threshold (e.g. 30 days). expired: today > expiryDate. missing_expiry_date: requiresLotTracking item received without expiryDate.
alertType.title: Alert Type

daysBeforeExpiry.description: Days before expiryDate at which the alert was raised (e.g. 30, 7). Null for expired and missing_expiry_date alerts.
daysBeforeExpiry.title: Days Before Expiry

alertDate.description: REQ-LOT-007: date the alert was raised by the daily check.
alertDate.title: Alert Date

status.description: Alert lifecycle state. pending: not yet seen by an operator. acknowledged: operator has seen it (silences the dashboard counter). resolved: action taken (lot quarantined/disposed/relabelled). Drives the lifecycle transitions.
status.title: Status

resolvedDate.description: Date the alert was acknowledged or resolved. Stamped automatically by the lifecycle action.
resolvedDate.title: Resolved Date

recipientId.description: FK to Person.id — the operator notified. Optional; alerts may be dashboard-only (no individual recipient).
recipientId.title: Recipient ID

administrationId.description: FK to Administration. Scoped per org so multi-tenant installs do not leak alerts across administrations.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

notes.description: Operator acknowledgement notes — free text recorded on the acknowledge or resolve transition.
notes.example: Geconstateerd, lot in quarantaine geplaatst voor inspectie.
notes.title: Notes

pending.label: Pending
pending.description: Alert raised but not yet seen. Counted on the expiry dashboard badge.

acknowledged.label: Acknowledged
acknowledged.description: Operator has seen the alert (suppresses the dashboard badge). No corrective action taken yet.

resolved.label: Resolved
resolved.description: Terminal. Corrective action taken (lot quarantined, disposed, or relabelled). Stamps resolvedDate.

acknowledge.label: Acknowledge
acknowledge.description: Operator marks the alert as seen.

resolve.label: Resolve
resolve.description: Operator marks the alert resolved after corrective action. Stamps resolvedDate.
